title: Kachumar (Cucumber, Onion, and Tomato Relish)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: A spicy relish to eat alongside other food; too strong to eat alone as a salad.

items: 1 cup peeled cucumber, in ¼ in (6 mm) dice
½ cup cilantro, finely chopped (or ⅓ cup mint leaves, no stems)
3 green chilies in thin rings, or 1 jalapeño finely chopped (optional)

steps.action: Adjust salt; transfer to a serving dish.

edits: Ground roasted cumin: see the Raita note
